citation: i2spec, Phase C trial fit (2026-09-18). Not a published parameter set.
fitted_to: the published B levels for v'' <= 44 at J = 0, 40, 80, 120, 160, and the 15 levels above v'' = 44 implied by the Salami & Ross atlas band shifts (contrast >= 1.9). C5, C6, C8 and C10 carry their published uncertainties and did not move; Te + De is tied to De(X) + 7602.9762 cm-1, the atomic splitting.
born_oppenheimer: taken unchanged from hannover2008 B (alpha and V_ad)
status: research result; the shipped model still uses hannover2008. Reproduces the published levels below v'' = 45 only to 204 MHz rms, which the joint fit has yet to fix.
